name: agenda
title: Agenda
description: A conference agenda across one or two days, with rooms and tracks, that knows what is on stage now. The page is plain HTML with every time written out in IST; with JavaScript each session may say 'Now on stage, until 11:15 am' or 'Next, at 2 pm' in words (never colour alone), finished ones go quiet but stay readable, and one calm status line follows the Indian clock once a minute. It never moves focus, never announces, and counts in Panjim's days whatever zone the visitor's machine is in.

budget.reason: Two modules: the pure now/next/finished core and wiring (recipe.js, 10,136 bytes) and the words by language (recipe.strings.js, 3,932 bytes, with each Konkani sentence in two scripts); 14,068 today, raised from 14,336 on 7 October 2026 so the next key is not the one that breaks it. It needs no component and no timer faster than a minute.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
